snip.t: The first and rate-limiting step of heme biosynthesis is condensation of glycine and succinyl-CoA to form δ-aminolevulinic acid (ALA).
Heme synthesis: Two molecules of succinyl-CoA and two molecules of glycine combine in mitochondria, catalyzed by ALA synthase, to form delta-aminolevulinic acid (ALA).
